statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor.
The service was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events over a prolonged monitoring period.
The associated diagnoses are I49.9 and R00.2.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered.
The procedure is medically necessary to correlate reported palpitations with underlying arrhythmia over an extended period.
